script.text: Loading ARC-V histories…
This is the story of Yuya Sakaki: Some call him a hero, some call him a goofball, and others call him a heroic goofball.
But before the end of his journey, Yuya Sakaki will travel through multiple dimensions and confront countless adversaries to save the world.
And little did Yuya know that his epic tale would begin with one small life lesson from his dad…
Take your dad's advice, Yuya. Try to laugh when you feel like crying. When things get tough… respond with a smile.
It will give you the strength to keep moving forward!
It's kind of like a pendulum. If the pendulum swings one way, you know it will swing the other way too.
Like in a duel!
A duel?
The key to dueling is to believe in your deck… and yourself.
When you're falling behind, you can always make things swing your way again.
So don't worry about anything. Just try to enjoy the ride. Try to remember what I've told you, Yuya. It may help you someday…
Several days later, Yusho was set to defend his Action Duel Championship title against the #1 contender: The Sledgehammer.
However, not only did Yuya's father fail to show up, he was never seen again. This branded Yusho – and the whole Sakaki family – as cowards.

Three years later… 
At Skip Boyle's You Show Dueling School:
Alright Yuya, it's time to take center stage and show Gong what you're made of!
It's showtime! Ladies, Gentlemen – and Gong – how ‘bout I kick off this round's entertainment with some carnival-craving hippos!
Quit goofing around, Yuya!
Why do you have to turn everything into a joke, Yuya?
There's nothing wrong with giving the fans a good laugh.
When your daddy was on the field, he had all the fans smiling.
He made duel-taining entertaining. Your duels are usually just embarrassing!
Well, if you ask me, my dad's last duel was pretty embarrassing too!
Yuya!
Afternoon, all! I do hope I'm not intruding!
Who are you?
I'm Nico Smiley, dueling manager and promoter. Currently, I represent the reigning Action Duel Champion: The Sledgehammer!
Not The Sledgehammer!
The Sledgehammer is hosting a Fan Appreciation Day at the Leo Institute. And he's issuing a one-on-one dueling challenge to Yuya.
You're inviting me… to duel The Sledgehammer!?
It's your chance to make up for your father's disappearing act.
I will never let Yuya take part in this match. The boy's suffered enough since his father disappeared.
That's a real shame. ‘Cause if you had agreed, the Leo Corp would've donated the newest Augmented Reality Combat system to your school…
...for no charge.
As in free.
You've got a deal!
You just said you'd never let Yuya duel The Sledgehammer!
Um well…
Yeah! We gotta have Yuya's back!
Right, Yuya? …Yuya? He… ran off.
Just like his old man!
Fan Appreciation Day:
Three years ago, the famous dueltainer Yusho Sakaki failed to defend his title against The Sledgehammer!
Now Sakaki's own son will try to erase that disgrace!
Do you think Yuya will show up?
Who knows? But Gong's gut says he will.
Much to everyone's surprise, Yuya did show up to duel. But as an even bigger surprise, Yuya was dressed as a clown.
Do not tell me you are the son of Yusho!?
Yep, the one an' only! Well? Are you ready to get this show on the road?
You won't be so insolent once The Sledgehammer squashes you!
